verified_improvements: The legacy run_clock symbol is removed and build_period_run now delegates to an internally driven simulate_period path.
DecisionTrace now contains explicit score, row, state, weight, return, cost, wealth, segment, recovery, regime, and terminal evidence fields.
score_at now checks synchronized BTC and ETH event timestamps, causal availability, daily continuity, finite positive values, and unique identities within its retained lookback.
run_development_folds materializes fresh calls for all four fold boundaries, all seven trials, doubled-cost stresses, and delayed stresses on synthetic in-memory inputs.
terminal_material_failures: The independent oracle file is byte-identical to repair 2 and still exposes only partial cutoff, vector, clock, target, rebalance, and scalar-gate helpers. It cannot recompute or reconcile the expanded production trace, score identities, quarantine/recovery/folds, bootstrap, DSR/PBO, multiplicity registry, regimes, or nineteen gates.
No frozen 49-slot constructor or first 56/35/21 transition implementation was added. MultiplicityRegistry remains a generic caller-supplied primitive and has no substantive test.

simulate_period initializes recovery to 150, resets it to zero only after score_at becomes incomplete, increments it on later complete records, but never conditions decision eligibility on recovery reaching 150. A first complete session after quarantine can therefore generate risk immediately.

simulate_period treats score incompleteness as a quarantine event only when a synchronized priced vector already exists. It has no representation for a missing due execution vector, no fail-closed unpriced exposed-liquidation path, and accrues the prior exposure across the interval before labeling the later vector as a priced liquidation, so no-bridge and gap precedence are not established.

The fold runner selects vectors by timestamp but passes all observations before fold end without binding a distinct start-aware warmup versus PnL window in its returned trace; the tests do not execute the runner across all four boundaries.

The final tests still contain the specifically forbidden placeholders: 36 allowlist evidence is replaced by a trial-count/vector assertion; 150-session recovery is replaced by a constant and 149-vector count; four folds are replaced by one BoundaryIndex boundary; seven independent simulations are replaced by TrialSpec object identities; DSR uses a broad zero-to-one range; bootstrap calls PBO instead of stationary_bootstrap; the no-performance evidence test checks terminal cash; and the governance test checks constants.
No exhaustive production-versus-copied-v1 decision parity grid and no full production-versus-oracle base/delayed/quarantine/recovery/fold trace reconciliation were added.
The live final-repair model explicitly reports failure and the same unresolved defects. Passing 306 controller and deterministic tests cannot override those behavior-level failures.
